page.content:
Mexico — Brazil's crowning side in the first color-TV World Cup.

How 1970 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Pelé — Pelé's 1970 Brazil side is the tournament's most quoted champion.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 1970 tournament is Brazil's crowning World Cup side.
  • Location: Estadio Azteca — The 1970 World Cup final was played at Estadio Azteca.

What is 1970 FIFA World Cup?

The 1970 World Cup in Mexico is remembered as Brazil's greatest side: Pelé, Jairzinho, Carlos Alberto's final goal, and the first tournament widely watched in color.

Key threads lead to Pelé, FIFA World Cup and Estadio Azteca.
